raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #35691.

SGLang hardcodes the OpenTelemetry `service.name` as `sglang`, so separate deployments appear as one service in tracing backends. This change lets deployments select a name with `--otlp-service-name`, falling back to `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` and then `sglang`.

## Modifications

- Declare the optional CLI field in the current `Observability` namespace; retain the existing positional `ServerArgs` constructor order.
- Read the published observability setting in the HTTP server, Engine, Scheduler, DP Controller, and disaggregated Encoder tracing initialization paths.
- Resolve the service name once before constructing the OpenTelemetry resource and pass that same name to the async exporter.
- Document the option and its precedence in the server argument reference and tracing guide.
- Cover CLI parsing, namespace projection, environment fallback, and actual SDK span resources. The exporter test checks all four precedence/fallback cases with async tracing both enabled and disabled, without sending telemetry over the network.

The branch includes upstream `main` at `6ba96d329fb838d7028b5f3db4f5dbc3fb8e366d`, including the required CI baseline `3700c4ee26a1df3fd27e10a4a83d40d991d87d6b`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: only tracing resource metadata changes; model outputs are unaffected.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: service-name resolution runs only during tracing initialization.

## Validation

CPU validation with the real OpenTelemetry SDK and both OTLP exporters installed:

- `python test/registered/unit/observability/test_trace.py -f`: 54 tests passed; no skipped OpenTelemetry tests.
- `pytest test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py -q`: 235 passed, 46 subtests passed (includes CLI parsing coverage).
- `pytest test/registered/unit/test_server_args_namespaces.py -q`: 5 passed.
- `pytest test/registered/unit/test_runtime_context_config_bags.py -q`: 18 passed, 8 subtests passed.
- All applicable pre-commit hooks passed for the 11 files changed against upstream main, including formatting, lint, registered-test validation, and conflict checks.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the contribution guide.
- [x] Add focused CPU unit tests.
- [x] Update the relevant documentation.
- [x] State why accuracy and speed benchmarks are not applicable.
- [x] Follow the current runtime-context configuration conventions.

+    To distinguish multiple SGLang deployments in your tracing backend, set a service name with `--otlp-service-name`:
+    ```bash Command
+    python -m sglang.launch_server \
+      --enable-trace \
+      --otlp-traces-endpoint 0.0.0.0:4317 \
+      --otlp-service-name sglang-production \
+      <other options>
+    ```
+    If you omit `--otlp-service-name`, SGLang uses the standard `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` environment variable when it is set and defaults to `sglang` otherwise. The CLI option takes precedence over the environment variable.

     To use the HTTP/protobuf span exporter, set the following environment variable and point to an HTTP endpoint, for example, `http://0.0.0.0:4318/v1/traces`.
